title: Aromatic Smoky Polish Beef Bake
description: A hearty Polish dish featuring minced beef, baked in a Korean brass bowl with a smoky flavor, mustardy taste, and crumbly texture, perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Mix the minced beef, flour, mustard, marjoram, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper in a large bowl until just combined.
Transfer the beef mixture to a Korean brass bowl.
Pour the beef broth over the beef mixture.
Dot the top of the beef mixture with the butter.
Cover the bowl with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Remove the bowl from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
